hero.title: Where You'll Find Us Next
hero.subtitle: Divrit Technologies actively participates in top tech conferences, industry expos, and networking summits — connecting with global partners, clients, and the latest innovations.

intro.label: ✦ Our Presence
intro.heading: Active Participants in the Global Tech Ecosystem
intro.description: We believe staying connected with the industry is what keeps our work sharp. Our team regularly attends leading tech events — learning, networking, and showcasing what Divrit Technologies stands for on a global stage.

upcomingEvents.title: Google Cloud Next 2025
upcomingEvents.description: The world's biggest Google Cloud event. Our team will be attending to explore the latest in AI infrastructure, cloud-native development, and enterprise solutions.

upcomingEvents.title: NASSCOM Technology & Leadership Forum 2025
upcomingEvents.description: India's most prestigious tech leadership forum. We'll be representing Divrit Technologies and connecting with India's top IT decision-makers and innovators.

upcomingEvents.title: AWS re:Invent 2025
upcomingEvents.description: Amazon's annual cloud computing conference. Our engineering team attends every year to stay ahead of the latest AWS services, architecture patterns, and DevOps innovations.

upcomingEvents.title: India Mobile Congress 2025
upcomingEvents.description: Asia's largest tech, telecom & startup event. We'll be there exploring the future of mobile technology, 5G, and connected devices alongside India's brightest tech minds.

upcomingEvents.title: Smart India Hackathon 2025
upcomingEvents.description: India's biggest hackathon platform. Divrit Technologies participates as a mentor organization, supporting teams solving real-world problems with technology.
upcomingEvents.organizer: Ministry of Education, Govt. of India

upcomingEvents.title: TiE Delhi-NCR Annual Summit
upcomingEvents.description: A premier entrepreneurship and startup networking event. Our leadership team connects with founders, investors, and enterprise decision-makers in the Delhi-NCR ecosystem.

whyAttend.title: Stay Ahead of the Curve
whyAttend.description: Industry events give our team first-hand access to the latest technologies, frameworks, and trends before they go mainstream — so our clients always get cutting-edge solutions.

whyAttend.title: Build Global Partnerships
whyAttend.description: Every event is an opportunity to connect with global vendors, cloud providers, and technology partners — expanding the ecosystem we can leverage for our clients.

whyAttend.title: Represent Our Clients
whyAttend.description: When Divrit attends events, we carry our clients' ambitions with us — learning what's next so we can apply it directly to the products we build for them.

whyAttend.title: Industry Recognition
whyAttend.description: Our participation in events like Amazon SPN Excellence Awards reflects the quality of work we deliver — building credibility that directly benefits every client we serve.

testimonials.text: Knowing that Divrit actively participates in global tech events gives me confidence. They're always current, always learning, and it shows in their work.

testimonials.text: Their team came back from AWS re:Invent and immediately suggested architecture improvements for our platform. That kind of proactive thinking is rare.
testimonials.name: Priya Sharma

testimonials.text: The recognition Divrit received at Amazon's own awards ceremony told me everything I needed to know about their credibility before I signed the contract.
testimonials.name: Dr. Anil Kapoor

faqs.question: Can we meet the Divrit team at an upcoming event?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! If you're attending any of the events listed here, reach out to us at info@divritin.com and we'll arrange a meeting. We love connecting with potential clients and partners in person.

faqs.question: Does Divrit sponsor or speak at industry events?
faqs.answer: We are open to speaking opportunities at relevant tech events. Our leadership team has spoken on topics including AI product development, e-commerce technology, and cloud-native architecture. Contact us for speaking enquiries.

faqs.question: How does attending events benefit your clients?
faqs.answer: Every event our team attends translates directly into better solutions for our clients. We bring back cutting-edge knowledge, new tools, and partnerships that we apply to the products we build.

faqs.question: Do you attend events outside India?
faqs.answer: Yes! We regularly attend global events like Google Cloud Next and AWS re:Invent in the US, alongside India-focused events like NASSCOM and India Mobile Congress — giving us both a global and local perspective.

cta.heading: Meet Us at Our Next Event
cta.subtitle: Planning to attend any of these events? Let's connect in person.
